e-reply-by-email.4.evidence: Same inbound with a '> On Tuesday, Alice wrote:' quoted block and '-- ' signature -> stored reply content_plain is only 'Thanks, restarting the queue worker fixed it for me.' (reply deleted afterwards).

e-reply-by-email.5.evidence: Inbound with To reply+garbage@... -> 400 jetonomy_reply_token_invalid 'Invalid token structure.'; a token with a tampered body -> 400 'Malformed token.'

e-reply-by-email.7.evidence: Unsigned inbound -> 403 jetonomy_webhook_missing_signature 'Webhook request is not signed.'; wrong signature -> 403 jetonomy_webhook_signature_invalid 'Webhook signature mismatch.'

e-reply-by-email.9.evidence: Signed payload without To -> 400 'No To address found in payload.'; To without a reply token -> 400 'No reply token found in To address.'

e-reply-by-email.8.evidence: Before configuring, POST inbound answered 503 jetonomy_extension_disabled 'Reply by Email is not set up yet.' (provider imap, not ready); the extension-off -> rest_no_route leg was not run.
